name: Hint text in a small corner box, status clear of the debug window
body: Dean (2026-11-19, station level): the Gems/Words/Meals status bar is overlapped by the debug window, and the hint line ("Buy a ticket at the machine (F beside i...") is huge, runs off the screen edge and sits over the debug window. Move the hint into a small box in a corner that wraps long text, and keep the status line clear of the debug window.

comments.text: Done (D-223): status top right, hint wrapped in a bottom right box. mist run test passes (302 of 302); checked by lavapipe screenshot of the station.

plan: Status line moves to the top right at 16 px. The hint goes in its own signal (ui.hint) and renders as wrapped lines in a small box at the bottom right. The centre message stays for rule messages such as level complete. Chaos UI has no text wrapping, so the game wraps the line into rows; an engine-side wrap is left for a later card.
acceptance_criteria: The status line never overlaps the debug window
A long hint wraps inside a box in a corner and stays on screen
Screenshots are in the project thread
